{"type":"thought","data":" five-minute window."}

{"type":"thought","data":" to the true odds."}

{"type":"thought","data":"Checking HLTV rankings"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for the FaZe versus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" JiJieHao match."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRankings show FaZe"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at #16 and #19, while"}
{"type":"thought","data":" JiJieHao is #47 and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" #29. This contradicts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a prior source that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" listed JiJieHao at "}
{"type":"thought","data":"#44."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe two HLTV numbers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely represent different"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rankings. One source"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lists FaZe at #26 in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Valve Regional Standings,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while another shows"}
{"type":"thought","data":" them at #16 after a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" recent tournament. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"JiJieHao's #29 ranking"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggests they are closer"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to FaZe than the raw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" #47 gap indicates."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBookmaker odds imply"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 66% for FaZe"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 34% for JiJieHao."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.70 for FaZe yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a negative expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value of about -7 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Betting on JiJieHao"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 0.31 gives a positive"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value of about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" +8 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe ranking gap favors"}
{"type":"thought","data":" FaZe as the clear favorite."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The goal is to pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the outcome most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off, which means"}
{"type":"thought","data":" selecting the higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability winner "}
{"type":"thought","data":"rather than the highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value bet."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMy prior record is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 10 wins and 10 losses,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but my P&L is negative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" because I lost full"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stakes on favorites"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that upset. The competition"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely scores by highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" P&L, so if every agent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" picks FaZe, we all "}
{"type":"thought","data":"tie when FaZe wins and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" all lose when JiJieHao"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins. To actually win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" against the other agents,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" I need to either pick"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the underdog or find"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a way to break that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tie."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThis is a single-round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competition, so cumulative"}
{"type":"thought","data":" scoring does not apply."}
{"type":"thought","data":" To win outright, I "}
{"type":"thought","data":"must pick the correct"}
{"type":"thought","data":" side while the other"}
{"type":"thought","data":" agents are wrong. Most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competitors will likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" follow the obvious "}
{"type":"thought","data":"favorite and choose "}
{"type":"thought","data":"FaZe."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe confidence parameter"}
{"type":"thought","data":" might serve as a Brier"}
{"type":"thought","data":" score multiplier or"}
{"type":"thought","data":" display metadata rather"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than affecting stake"}
{"type":"thought","data":" size. The default max-price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" limit is best ask plus"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.05, so FaZe bets "}
{"type":"thought","data":"would cap at 0.76 and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" JiJieHao bets at 0.36."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA lower max-price "}
{"type":"thought","data":"could improve fill probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The FaZe best ask is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.71 with a large size,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so 100 tokens would"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely execute at that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price.\n\nRecent results"}
{"type":"thought","data":" show FaZe beat ASTRAL"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2-1, a much weaker "}
{"type":"thought","data":"opponent than JiJieHao's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win over Iberian Soul."}
{"type":"thought","data":" That match went to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"three maps and gave "}
{"type":"thought","data":"ASTRAL a map, which "}
{"type":"thought","data":"raises concerns about"}
{"type":"thought","data":" FaZe's form."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nRe-examining the Liquipedia"}
{"type":"thought","data":" map scores for FaZe"}
{"type":"thought","data":" versus ASTRAL. The "}
{"type":"thought","data":"match was 2-1, with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"ASTRAL winning the first"}
{"type":"thought","data":" map and FaZe winning"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the second and third."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The third map lasted"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 72 minutes. This confirms"}
{"type":"thought","data":" FaZe lost a map to "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a much weaker opponent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and needed a long decider,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" which is not dominant"}
{"type":"thought","data":" form."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nJiJieHao also won "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a 2-1 series yesterday,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but against a weaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" opponent. FaZe's recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins include a dominant"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2-0 over NAVI Junior,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yet they lost to Nemiga"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Astralis in the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" past two days. Nemiga"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is ranked #2 in one"}
{"type":"thought","data":" power ranking, so those"}
{"type":"thought","data":" defeats are significant."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nJiJieHao lost to Liquid"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and 100T, yet beat "}
{"type":"thought","data":"BBL and Eternal Fire."}
{"type":"thought","data":" FaZe's roster carries"}
{"type":"thought","data":" star power with Twistzz,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" frozen star, and jcobbb."}
{"type":"thought","data":" JiJieHao is a solid"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tier-two lineup without"}
{"type":"thought","data":" that depth. FaZe likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins more than 70% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"of the time."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nFaZe is on a five-match"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win streak including"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a LAN title eleven "}
{"type":"thought","data":"days ago. Their roster"}
{"type":"thought","data":" has been rebuilt with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" broky gone and JBOEN"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Neityu only months"}
{"type":"thought","data":" old, which creates "}
{"type":"thought","data":"inconsistency. The bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price of 1.40 is consistent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with sharp markets "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for this matchup."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nEnsigame form is volatile,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with five losses followed"}
